title: Public Alert No. 027/2026 -Alert on European Union Ban on the Sale and Orders the Destruction of Defective Signo FFP2 Particle Filter Mask Produced in China

products.manufacturer: Shenzhen Signo Group Technology Co. Ltd.

summary: NAFDAC relays an EU RAPEX ban and destruction order for SIGNO FFP2 non-reusable particle filter masks made in China by Shenzhen Signo Group Technology Co. Ltd. Filtration is insufficient (mean 32.3%), failing PPE Regulation and EN 149. Not in NAFDAC database.
